verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUKAMA waffe-ow'ekisa,
Tusonyiwe fenna;
-Ebirowoozo-ebitukuvu
N'empisa ezisaanira
-Otujjuzenga fenna.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ku nnyanja,abtume bo
Baakuwuliranga;
Fenna fenna tusituke
Era tukugoberere
Amangu nga bali.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tujjukira ennyanja eyo
N'ensozi ennungi;
Yesu kwe yafukamira
Ng'asba-eri Katonda we
Atwagala fenna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Otereeze-emyoyo gyaffe
Ennaku ziggweewo;
-Emitima nga giteredde
gijjukire-emirembe gyo
Egitasingika.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Era okwegomba kwaffe
Kumalibwe mu ggwe;
Eby'omubiri n'eby'ensi
Bisirike,tuwulire,
By'oyogera naffe.
